subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp and preview land independently now, or be folded into broader Sessions overview work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support the requested preview data, but the visible Control UI table design overlaps with broader open issues about session overview, derived titles, sorting, peek behavior, and inline reply.

options.title: Land Narrow Preview
options.body: Repair or replace the linked PR with a focused implementation that uses `includeLastMessage`, renders a compact preview, and adds focused Control UI tests.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Overview
options.body: Keep this request linked to the broader Sessions overview direction and close or pause the narrow PR after naming that canonical design path.

options.title: Defer Preview UI
options.body: Leave the Sessions page as a technical management table for now and document the maintainer rationale before closing paired implementation attempts.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Preview
recommendation.body: Repair or replace the linked PR with a focused implementation that uses `includeLastMessage`, renders a compact preview, and adds focused Control UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged cross-client Sessions work makes this the clearest available owner for the product-scope choice.
